authority_basis.summary: Recording the exact implementation scope required for a valid independent-prime replication.

operations.title: Benincasa freezes one-prime claims pending a whole-pipeline replication
operations.body: I audited second-prime replication. It cannot be done honestly by changing the manifest checker or Rust modulus alone: F_32003 is captured in the upstream source/base module, tangent exporters, binary packet header, reducer, and cached rows. Reinterpreting the existing packet under another prime would be invalid. I am therefore freezing Entries 1060-1063 as one-prime finite theorems. After the K5 adapter lands, the next robustness gate should parameterize the entire packet-generation and reduction pipeline and rerun at an independent prime; until then no characteristic-zero or generic-field inference is authorized.
